name: Gurpreet WebTranslator AI
author: Gurpreet Singh

sections.description:
Gurpreet WebTranslator AI connects your WordPress site to the world’s most advanced Neural Machine Translation engine powered by advanced neural AI technology to translate your content instantly.

Unlike standard auto-translators that merely swap text on the fly using JavaScript (which search engines often miss), Gurpreet WebTranslator AI creates real, permanent, and separate posts and pages for every translation.

This strategy, known as “Content Expansion”, is the gold standard for international SEO.

Why choose Gurpreet WebTranslator AI?

  • 🚀 True SEO Superpower: Because the plugin generates actual WordPress posts (e.g., your-site.com/french-news), Google and other search engines can index your content in every language.
    This helps you rank for keywords globally and drives new organic traffic that simple “language switchers” miss.
  • ⚡ The “Content Factory” Workflow: Turn one English post into 50+ global posts in seconds.
    Save hours of manual copying, pasting, and formatting.
  • 🎨 Layout & Design Safe: Our intelligent engine understands WordPress Blocks (Gutenberg), Shortcodes, and HTML structure.
    It translates the text while keeping your design, images, and forms perfectly intact.
  • 🛒 WooCommerce Native: Translates complex products (Titles, Descriptions, Summaries) while intelligently preserving critical data like Price, SKU, Stock, and Images.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Native Translation: Generates a separate, fully editable WordPress Post, Page, or Product for each language.
  • Search Engine Optimized: Creates indexable URLs for every language version, boosting your site’s global visibility.
  • WooCommerce Ready: Deep integration for Product translation—sells in any language without breaking your inventory or pricing.
  • Smart Context Awareness: Skips code blocks, shortcodes, and technical metadata to prevent site errors.
  • 50+ Languages: Support for Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, and many more.
  • Flexible Organization: Since translations are real posts, you can easily manage them using standard Categories (e.g., “Hindi Blog”) or Tags to keep your site organized.

Privacy & 3rd Party Service Disclosure
This plugin relies on a 3rd party SaaS service (WebTranslator AI) to process translations.

  • Your content (titles, post content, excerpts) is sent to our servers (https://webtranslator-ai.onrender.com) for processing via our external AI translation service.
  • We do not store your content permanently; it is processed and returned immediately.
  • An API Key is required to use this service.
    You can obtain one by signing up at WebTranslator AI Dashboard.
  • Terms of Service: https://webtranslator-ai.onrender.com/terms.html
  • Privacy Policy: https://webtranslator-ai.onrender.com/privacy.html

Support & Documentation

Need help setting up? Found a bug?
* Help Center: View Documentation & Guides
* Community: Feel free to open a thread in the WordPress.org support tab.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gurpreet-webtranslator-ai directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Gurpreet WebTranslator AI menu in your dashboard.
  4. Enter your API Key (Get one from WebTranslator AI).
  5. Go to Posts, Pages, or Products and click the “Translate” button in the “WebTranslator AI” column.
sections.faq:
Is this free?

The plugin allows a limited number of free translations per month.
For higher volume, a paid plan is required via the external service.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes!
It translates product details while preserving price, stock, and images.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Your translations remain safe! Since Gurpreet WebTranslator AI creates real WordPress posts, disabling the plugin will NOT delete your translated content.
It simply stops the translation service.

Can I edit the translated content manually?

Absolutely.
Each translation is a standard WordPress post, page, or product.
You can open it in the editor and tweak the text just like any other post.

Is the translation SEO friendly?

Yes. Unlike JavaScript-based translators that search engines often ignore, this plugin creates indexable URLs for every language (e.g., /spanish-post/), which helps you rank globally.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The translation process happens in the background on your admin dashboard.
The final translated pages are served as standard HTML, ensuring maximum speed for your visitors.

Do I need an API Key?

Yes. To process translations securely via our neural engine, you need to connect the plugin to our service using a free API key obtained from your dashboard.

Which languages are supported?

We currently support major global languages including Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, and over 40 others.
